dotnet-type

Reads and writes legacy announcement-module data through the EF context.fallback: zh-CN

Reads and writes legacy announcement-module data through the EF context.

Localized Fields

summary

Reads and writes legacy announcement-module data through the EF context.

通过 EF 上下文读写旧公告模块数据。

remarks

This implementation only handles announcement persistence and module filtering; module-edit permission, item ownership checks, link policy, and display-time HTML encoding are handled by caller pages and module controls.

本实现只处理公告表的持久化和按模块过滤；模块编辑权限、条目归属校验、链接策略和展示层 HTML 编码由调用页与模块控件承担。

BusinessApplicationDb

dotnet-type

Abstract business-application data-access implementation backed by.fallback: zh-CN

Abstract business-application data-access implementation backed by.

Localized Fields

summary

Abstract business-application data-access implementation backed by.

基于的抽象业务申请数据访问实现。

remarks

The first P19.4 version handles only low-sensitivity plain-text applications, one-level review states, and workflow-event facts; page code records work-item projections and operation audits after business facts succeed. This class performs controlled SQL data access, but it does not authorize the current user or expand application facts, work-item projections, and operation audits into one cross-facade atomic transaction.

P19.4 第一版只处理低敏纯文本申请、单层审核状态和流程事件事实；待办投影与运营审计由页面层在业务事实写入成功后旁路记录。本类负责受控 SQL 数据访问，不负责当前用户授权，也不把申请事实、待办投影和运营审计扩展为一个跨门面原子事务。

Source

Defined in src/Portal/bin/Portal.Components.Data1.xml:1

IsSchemaAvailable

dotnet-method

Checks whether both the application and workflow-event tables are accessible.fallback: zh-CN

Checks whether both the application and workflow-event tables are accessible.

Localized Fields

summary

Checks whether both the application and workflow-event tables are accessible.

检查申请表和流程事件表是否同时可访问。

remarks

This is an availability probe. It guarantees neither a later successful write nor business authorization; missing tables, metadata-query failures, and connection errors are treated as unavailable.

这是一次可用性探测，不证明后续写入成功，也不执行业务授权；表缺失、元数据查询失败和连接异常均按不可用处理。

returns.summary

when both controlled tables are accessible; otherwise. true false

两个受控表均可访问时为，否则为。 true false

Source

Defined in src/Portal/bin/Portal.Components.Data1.xml:1

dotnet-method

Normalizes and submits one application fact together with its Submit workflow event.fallback: zh-CN

Normalizes and submits one application fact together with its Submit workflow event.

Localized Fields

summary

Normalizes and submits one application fact together with its Submit workflow event.

归一化并提交一条申请事实，同时写入 Submit 流程事件。

remarks

Null requests, missing required fields, unavailable schema, and SQL exceptions return low-sensitivity failure results. The application and Submit event are written in one SQL batch, but later work-item/audit sidecars are outside this method's transaction; the method also does not prove the caller's identity or submission authorization.

空请求、必填字段缺失、架构不可用和 SQL 异常均返回低敏失败结果。申请与 Submit 事件在同一 SQL 批次写入，但后续待办/审计旁路不属于本方法事务；本方法也不替调用方证明当前用户身份或提交权限。

params.request.summary

Submission parameters. The implementation copies, trims, and defaults the values without mutating the caller instance.

提交参数；实现会复制、裁剪并补默认值，不修改调用方实例。

returns.summary

The application identifier and code on success, or only a display-safe low-sensitivity explanation on failure.

成功时包含申请标识和编号；失败时只提供可展示的低敏说明。

ResubmitApplication

dotnet-method

Lets the applicant resubmit a returned business application, sending it back into the review window.fallback: zh-CN

Lets the applicant resubmit a returned business application, sending it back into the review window.

Localized Fields

summary

Lets the applicant resubmit a returned business application, sending it back into the review window.

申请人重提被退回的业务申请，把它送回待审核窗口。

remarks

This method is an applicant self-service action and writes no reviewer fields. Ownership and status conditions live in the same UPDATE statement (`ApplicantUserId` and `ApplicationStatus = Returned`), so there is no read-then-write window. Because a table check constraint requires the review time and reviewer to be null in thestate, the statement must clear both or the constraint rejects the change; the review comment column is retained while the authoritative history lives in transition events. Submitted

本方法是申请人自助动作，不写入审核人字段。归属与状态条件写在同一个 UPDATE 语句中（`ApplicantUserId` 与 `ApplicationStatus = Returned`），因此不存在"先查后改"的中间窗口。由于表的检查约束要求状态下审核时间与审核人都为空，语句必须同时把这两列置空，否则会被约束拒绝；审核意见列被保留，权威历史由迁移事件承载。 Submitted

The business application identifier.

业务申请标识。

提交人门户用户标识。

params.actorName.summary

Actor account name or system identifier.

操作人账号名或系统标识。

returns.summary

The resubmission result, with a low-sensitivity explanation on failure.

重提结果；失败时为低敏说明。

HasTable

dotnet-method

Probes whether a database object exists by table name, used to decide before reads or writes whether a migration has already run. The table name is interpolated into the SQL string — the only place in this class where an identifier is not parameterized — so the **safety invariant** must hold: callers may pass only compile-time constants (this class's/, or literal table names within this file), never an identifier from a page, query string, or any other external input. Ordinary static checks cannot prove that constraint, so it is registered here explicitly.fallback: zh-CN

Probes whether a database object exists by table name, used to decide before reads or writes whether a migration has already run. Ordinary static checks cannot prove that constraint, so it is registered here explicitly.

Ordinary static checks cannot prove that constraint, so it is registered here explicitly.

按表名探测数据库对象是否存在，用于在读写前判断迁移是否已执行。 表名以字符串内插进 SQL —— 这是本类唯一不把标识符参数化的地方，因此**安全不变量**必须成立： 调用方只允许传入编译期常量（本类的/， 或同一文件内的字面量表名），绝不允许传入来自页面、查询串或任何外部输入的标识符。 该约束无法由普通静态检查证明，故在此显式登记。

HasColumn

dotnet-method

Probes whether a column exists, used for deployment-level migrations such as the P47.1 parent column: the column may be absent before the migration runs, so it is probed before reads to choose either the real column projection or a NULL projection, avoiding read failures on older databases. TryGetActorAuthorization

dotnet-method

Resolves an actor's authorization snapshot over a collaboration item (permission key set and administrator flag).fallback: zh-CN

Resolves an actor's authorization snapshot over a collaboration item (permission key set and administrator flag).

Localized Fields

summary

Resolves an actor's authorization snapshot over a collaboration item (permission key set and administrator flag).

解析操作者在其协作事项上的授权快照（权限键集合与是否管理员）。

remarks

**Fail-closed invariant**: any missing prerequisite is judged "unauthorized" rather than allowed — no user id, an unavailable `usersDb`, no user found by id, an empty user name, or an exception during the read all return. When `rolesDb` is unavailable the permission key set is **empty**, which grants nothing (the administrator flag still depends on a role name or an explicit permission key and is never elevated by a missing dependency). Ordinary static checks cannot prove that constraint, so it is registered here explicitly: callers must never treat "authorization unavailable" as "authorized". false

**fail-closed 不变量**：任一前置缺失都判为"未授权"而不是放行 —— 无用户 Id、`usersDb` 不可用、 按 Id 找不到用户、用户名为空，或读取过程中抛异常，一律返回。`rolesDb` 不可用时权限键集合为**空**， 不会因此获得任何权限（管理员标志仍由角色名或显式权限键决定，不因依赖缺失而被提升）。 该约束无法由普通静态检查证明，故显式登记：调用方不得把"取不到授权"当作"有权限"处理。 false

params.actorUserId.summary

Actor user Id; empty or non-positive is judged unauthorized immediately.

操作者用户 Id；为空或非正数时直接判定为未授权。

params.authorization.summary

The authorization snapshot on success;on failure. null

成功时输出授权快照；失败时为。 null

returns.summary

when an authorization snapshot was obtained; otherwise. true false

取得授权快照时为；否则为。 true false

Data-access implementation for the legacy module-definition table.fallback: zh-CN

Data-access implementation for the legacy module-definition table.

Localized Fields

summary

Data-access implementation for the legacy module-definition table.

旧模块定义表的数据访问实现。

remarks

This class still serves the legacy Admin module-definition entry and runtime module assembly; the P3.2 module catalog constrains new module sources first, but the legacy definition table must remain readable, maintainable, and regression-testable. Trusted deployment path validation is performed by the calling page before writes.

该类仍服务于旧 Admin 模块定义入口和运行时模块装配；P3.2 模块目录机制会优先约束新模块来源，但旧定义表仍需要保持可读、可维护和可回归。写入前的可信部署路径校验由调用页面完成。

GetOrganizationUnitSubtreeIds

dotnet-method

Reads the identifier set of the organization subtree rooted at the specified unit (root included).fallback: zh-CN

Reads the identifier set of the organization subtree rooted at the specified unit (root included).

Localized Fields

summary

Reads the identifier set of the organization subtree rooted at the specified unit (root included).

读取以指定组织为根的子树组织单元标识集合（含根节点）。

remarks

Added in W68. The query reads only the two identifier columns needed for expansion, and the expansion itself runs through thepure function so this semantics stays unit testable without a database; the depth cap and the visited set together keep a malformed cycle from recursing forever. Failures always yield an empty set rather than degrading to a full scan.

W68 新增。取数只读取展开所需的两个标识列，展开由纯函数完成，因此这部分语义可在无数据库环境中被单测覆盖；深度上限与"已访问"集合共同保证即使出现环路也不会无限递归。失败一律返回空集合，不退化为全量。

params.organizationUnitId.summary

The subtree root organization unit identifier; a non-positive value yields an empty set.

子树根组织单元标识；非正值返回空集合。

returns.summary

The subtree identifier list (root included); empty when the schema is unavailable or reading fails.

子树组织单元标识列表（含根节点）；架构不可用或读取失败时为空列表。

EmployeeProfileCorrectionRequestDb

dotnet-type

Employee-profile correction-request data-access implementation backed by.fallback: zh-CN

Employee-profile correction-request data-access implementation backed by.

Localized Fields

summary

Employee-profile correction-request data-access implementation backed by.

基于的员工资料更正请求数据访问实现。

remarks

This implementation writes only requests and administrator review states. Employee master-data changes must still be performed through the employee-directory administration area or the formal approval workflow. Read paths fail softly when schema is missing or unavailable; write paths return low-sensitivity failures and leave detailed diagnostics to callers.

此实现只写入请求和管理员处理状态，不直接修改员工主数据。员工主数据修改仍应通过员工目录后台或正式审批机制完成。读取路径在缺表或异常时软失败，写入路径返回低敏失败消息，详细异常由调用方按场景写诊断日志。

Source

Withdraws a still-pending correction request submitted by the requesting user.fallback: zh-CN

summary

Withdraws a still-pending correction request submitted by the requesting user.

撤回本人提出的、尚在处理中的更正请求。

remarks

The request table constrains status to///and requires a review time and reviewer for any non-row. Withdrawal therefore reuses, records the requester as the actor, and leaves a note:and no new terminal semantics are introduced. Ownership mismatch, a disallowed status, or a missing request all fail without changing any row. Submitted Reviewed Closed Rejected Submitted Closed no schema migration is needed

请求表状态受检查约束限定为///，且非时必须同时具备审核时间与审核人。因此撤回复用并把提交人本人记为操作人，在备注中留痕：，也不引入新的终态语义。归属不符、状态不允许或请求不存在一律失败且不改变任何行。 Submitted Reviewed Closed Rejected Submitted Closed 无需任何架构迁移

params.userId.summary

The current Portal user identifier; a non-positive value fails.

当前门户用户标识；非正值返回失败。

params.requestId.summary

The correction request identifier; a non-positive value fails.

更正请求标识；非正值返回失败。

params.actorName.summary

Actor account name or system identifier; blank becomes. system

操作人账号名或系统标识；空白时使用。 system

returns.summary

The withdrawal result; failures carry a low-sensitivity explanation.

撤回结果；失败时包含低敏说明。

remarks

From W69 onward, an approval () first writes the proposed value into employee master data according to the server-side allow list and only then sets the status; a failed write, a manually handled field, or an unsupported field all leave the status unchanged. The organization display name is never written back automatically because it must map to an organization identifier and display names may be ambiguous. Reviewed

W69 起，审核通过（）会先按服务端白名单把建议值回写到员工主数据，成功后再置位；回写失败、字段需人工处理或字段不受支持时一律不置位，请求保持原状态。组织显示名因需映射为组织标识且存在重名歧义，不自动回写。 Reviewed

remarks

The caller retains ownership of the request object. An implementation may copy, trim, and default its values, but this method must not be relied on for business authorization. The reuse path does not promise to refresh an existing title, summary, assignment, or due time. Callers should inspectand must not treat its display message as authorization or an idempotency token.

This method does not enforce administration-page authorization; callers must restrict access first. The returned list and DTOs are mutable point-in-time projections and do not automatically reflect concurrent updates. The current implementation returns an empty list for unavailable schema or query failures, so an empty result cannot distinguish “no data” from “read failure.”

本方法不实施后台页面授权；调用方必须先限制访问。返回列表及其 DTO 是可变的时间点投影，不自动反映并发更新。当前实现对架构不可用或查询异常返回空列表，因此空列表不能区分“没有数据”和“读取失败”。

GetWorkItemsForUser

dotnet-method

Reads a snapshot of work items assigned to the specified user or to role keys the user holds, for the front-end "My To-Do Items" aggregation entry.fallback: zh-CN

Reads a snapshot of work items assigned to the specified user or to role keys the user holds, for the front-end "My To-Do Items" aggregation entry.

Localized Fields

summary

Reads a snapshot of work items assigned to the specified user or to role keys the user holds, for the front-end "My To-Do Items" aggregation entry.

读取指派给指定用户或其持有角色键的待办快照，用于前台"我的待办"聚合入口。

remarks

A row matches when the assigned user identifier equals the supplied user, or when the assigned role key falls inside the supplied controlled key set. This method does not resolve role membership; the caller resolves the key set with existing authorization capability. When the user identifier is non-positive and the key set is empty, the method fails closed with a successful but empty result instead of degrading to an unrestricted query. The result explicitly separates "succeeded with no matches" from "read failure".

命中条件为"指派用户标识等于传入用户"或"指派角色键落在传入的受控键集合内"。本方法不解析角色成员关系，键集合由调用方用既有授权能力解析后传入。用户标识非正数且键集合为空时按 fail-closed 返回成功但空的结果，不退化成全量查询。结果显式区分"成功且无命中"与"读取失败"。

params.userId.summary

The current Portal user identifier; a non-positive value disables matching by user identifier.

当前门户用户标识；非正数表示不按用户标识命中。

params.assignedRoleKeys.summary

The controlled role or permission keys held by the current user; may be null. Blank entries are discarded, duplicates are merged, and entries beyond the cap are truncated.

当前用户持有的受控角色或权限键集合；可为空。空白项被丢弃，重复项被合并，超出上限的部分被截断。

params.status.summary

Exact status filter; blank means unfinished items only (). The current implementation only trims the text and does not validate it against the constants.

精确状态筛选；空白表示仅未完成（）。当前实现只裁剪文本，不校验是否为常量。

params.take.summary

Requested maximum row count; non-positive values use 50 and the count is capped at 200.

期望最大条数；非正数使用 50，上限限制为 200。

returns.summary

A query result carrying the success flag and the newest-first projections; unavailable schema or query failures yield a failed result with an empty list.

包含成功标记与最新优先待办投影的查询结果；架构不可用或查询异常时返回失败结果且列表为空。

Normalizes a work-item creation request.

summary

Normalizes a work-item creation request.

标准化审批工作项创建请求。

remarks

`"system"` is a **fallback literal for a missing identity**, not a real identity: it only means "this creation recorded no specific actor", and audits or troubleshooting must not read it as automatic system execution. The fallback **does not replace the caller's duty to pass identity** — when a traceable creator is required the caller must pass it explicitly, otherwise the audit chain breaks on that record.

`"system"` 是**身份缺失时的兜底字面量**，不是真实身份：它只表示"本次创建未记录到具体操作者"， 审计与排查不得据此判定为系统自动执行。该兜底**不替代调用方传递身份的责任** —— 需要可追溯的创建者时调用方必须显式传入，否则审计链在该记录上断掉。

params.request.summary

returns.summary

裁剪长度、补齐默认 UTC 时间和系统操作者后的创建请求。

Resolve

Resolves one sign-in input to a unique Portal user.fallback: zh-CN

Resolves one sign-in input to a unique Portal user.

Localized Fields

summary

Resolves one sign-in input to a unique Portal user.

把一次登录输入解析为唯一门户用户。

remarks

The resolver first checks the new profile login name, then the legacy user name, then employee code, and finally merged email results. Not-found results from the first two unique-field checks may continue to later checks.

解析顺序优先使用新用户资料登录名，其次旧用户表名称，再尝试工号，最后合并邮箱结果。前两个唯一字段出现未命中时允许继续向后查找。

params.input.summary

User-entered login name, email address or employee code.

用户输入的登录名、邮箱或员工工号。

returns.summary

Resolution result; it may be uniquely found, ambiguous, not found or non-terminal.

解析结果；可能是唯一命中、歧义、未命中或未作终止判断。

dotnet-type

Strong password-hash helper for Portal P5.2.fallback: zh-CN

Strong password-hash helper for Portal P5.2.

Localized Fields

summary

Strong password-hash helper for Portal P5.2.

门户 P5.2 强密码哈希辅助器。

remarks

This helper is used only inside the data-access layer. It defaults to PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 and stores the iteration count on each credential, allowing later per-user cost upgrades. Callers must not log the submitted password, salt, or hash.

此类只在数据访问层内部使用。默认采用 PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256，并把迭代次数写入每条凭据，便于之后按用户渐进提高成本参数。调用方不得记录输入密码、盐或哈希。

UserEmployeeBindingInfo

dotnet-type

Default implementation of the Portal-user to employee binding read-only view.fallback: zh-CN

Default implementation of the Portal-user to employee binding read-only view.

Localized Fields

summary

Default implementation of the Portal-user to employee binding read-only view.

门户账号与员工绑定只读视图的默认实现。

remarks

This object is used by binding lists, binding details, and audit-friendly administration displays. It only represents the binding state that has already been queried and does not decide whether the current operator can modify the binding or increment a user's security version; those actions belong to write services or data access implementations.

该对象用于后台绑定列表、绑定详情和审计辅助展示。它只表达已经查询出的绑定状态，不负责判断当前操作者 是否可修改绑定，也不触发用户安全版本递增；这些动作属于后台写入服务或数据访问实现。

Source

绑定变更原因或备注；显示前需编码，且不应包含密码等敏感信息。

UserProfileInfo

dotnet-type

Default implementation of the Portal user-profile extension read-only view.fallback: zh-CN

Default implementation of the Portal user-profile extension read-only view.

Localized Fields

summary

Default implementation of the Portal user-profile extension read-only view.

门户用户资料扩展只读视图的默认实现。

remarks

This object merges query results from the legacy user table and the newer user-profile extension table into a read-only view for user administration and enterprise identity pages. It does not contain passwords, cookies, security versions, or role lists; authentication, authorization, and session invalidation remain owned by dedicated services.

该对象把旧用户表和新用户资料扩展表的查询结果合并为只读视图，供后台用户管理和企业身份相关页面展示。 它不包含口令、Cookie、安全版本或角色列表；认证、授权和会话失效判断应继续通过专门服务完成。

Source

构造函数统一把可空文本归一化为空字符串，减少 Web Forms 控件绑定时的空值判断噪声。

params.userId.summary

Portal user primary key.

门户用户主键。

params.legacyName.summary

Original name from the legacy user table, used for compatibility display and migration review.

旧用户表中的原始名称，用于兼容显示和迁移核对。

params.loginName.summary

Current login or account name; presentation code must still encode it before output.

当前登录名或账号名；展示层输出前仍需编码。

params.displayName.summary

User display name, primarily used by the enterprise portal UI.

用户显示名称，优先服务企业门户界面展示。

params.nickname.summary

User nickname or short name; pages decide fallback display when empty.

用户昵称或短名称；为空时由页面决定回退显示。

params.preferredEmail.summary

Preferred contact email; this is not an authentication credential.

首选联系邮箱；不是认证凭据。

params.status.summary

Stable user-profile status string.

用户资料状态稳定字符串。

params.statusReason.summary

Status reason or note; encode before display and do not include secrets.

状态原因或备注；显示前需编码，且不应包含敏感值。

params.isAvailable.summary

Whether the profile is currently available for page display or administration selection.

当前资料是否可用于页面展示或后台选择。

params.source.summary

Profile source marker used to distinguish legacy table, extension table, or extended synchronization sources.

资料来源标识，用于区分旧表、扩展表或扩展同步来源。

UserRegistrationInfo

dotnet-type

User registration review metadata DTO.fallback: zh-CN

User registration review metadata DTO.

Localized Fields

summary

User registration review metadata DTO.

用户注册审核元数据 DTO。

remarks

This type is used by administration review, registration status display, and low-sensitivity messages. The constructor normalizes nullable strings to empty strings so legacy Web Forms binding code does not repeat null checks; it does not contain passwords, cookies, or exception details.

该类型面向后台审核、注册状态展示和低敏提示。构造函数会把可空字符串归一化为空字符串， 避免旧 Web Forms 绑定层反复做空值判断；它不包含口令、Cookie 或异常细节。

Source

remarks

The security version is written into both the Forms Authentication ticket and the role cookie. High-value state changes such as password reset or role-membership updates increment the version so older tickets become invalid on the next request.

RolesDb

dotnet-type

Data-access implementation for legacy portal roles, role membership, and role-permission mappings.fallback: zh-CN

Data-access implementation for legacy portal roles, role membership, and role-permission mappings.

Localized Fields

summary

Data-access implementation for legacy portal roles, role membership, and role-permission mappings.

旧门户角色、成员关系和角色权限映射的数据访问实现。

remarks

This type still maintains the legacy `Portal_Roles` / `Portal_UserRoles` structures directly. Write paths that change membership or role permissions increment affected users' security versions so older authentication tickets are re-evaluated on the next request.

本类型仍直接维护旧 `Portal_Roles` / `Portal_UserRoles` 结构。会改变角色成员或角色权限的写入路径会递增受影响用户的安全版本，使旧认证票据在下一请求重新判定。

Source

GetRolePermissionEntries

dotnet-method

Reads a read-only projection of every role-permission mapping so the capability permission matrix can present the current state by capability layer, permission category, and role.fallback: zh-CN

Reads a read-only projection of every role-permission mapping so the capability permission matrix can present the current state by capability layer, permission category, and role.

summary

Reads a read-only projection of every role-permission mapping so the capability permission matrix can present the current state by capability layer, permission category, and role.

读取全部角色权限映射的只读投影，供能力权限矩阵按"能力层 → 权限分类 → 角色"呈现现状。

remarks

Read-only implementation: it reuses the table-existence guard and failure degradation (empty result instead of an exception) of the existing permission query, and it writes nothing, increments no security version, and caches nothing. `IsEnabled` is projected straight from the effective database state, and a disabled mapping must never be rendered as "not granted".

只读实现：使用与既有权限查询一致的表存在性守卫与失败降级（返回空集合而非抛异常），不写库、不递增安全版本、不缓存。`IsEnabled` 直接投影数据库生效态，禁用映射不得被展示为"未授权"。

returns.summary

Mappings ordered by role name and permission key; empty when the permission table is missing or the query fails.

UsersDb

dotnet-type

User, credential, and registration-review data-access implementation backed by the Portal security database context.fallback: zh-CN

User, credential, and registration-review data-access implementation backed by the Portal security database context.

Localized Fields

summary

User, credential, and registration-review data-access implementation backed by the Portal security database context.

基于门户安全数据库上下文的用户、凭据和注册审核数据访问实现。

remarks

Starting with P5.2, newly created, registered, and reset passwords are written to thestrong-hash table, whilemaintains the session security version. Legacy MD5 values inare used only for the first compatibility sign-in of users that have not yet been upgraded; once a strong credential exists, sign-in must not fall back to the legacy column. This class only accesses credential/security-state data and constructs results; it does not authorize pages, issue cookies, or write password values to logs. Portal_UserCredentials Portal_UserSecurityStates Portal_Users.Password

P5.2 起，新建、注册和重置密码写入强哈希表，并通过维护会话安全版本。旧中的 MD5 仅用于尚未升级用户的首次兼容登录；一旦强哈希凭据存在，登录不得再回退到旧字段。本类只负责凭据/状态数据访问与结果构造，不负责页面授权、Cookie 签发或把密码值写入日志。 Portal_UserCredentials Portal_UserSecurityStates Portal_Users.Password

SignIn

dotnet-method

Resolves the sign-in identifier, then validates the submitted password, registration-review status, and P5.2 strong credential.fallback: zh-CN

Resolves the sign-in identifier, then validates the submitted password, registration-review status, and P5.2 strong credential.

Localized Fields

summary

Resolves the sign-in identifier, then validates the submitted password, registration-review status, and P5.2 strong credential.

解析登录标识并校验输入密码、注册审核状态和 P5.2 强凭据。

remarks

The method returns only outcome, reset-required, and security-version facts, not failure details. The identifier is normalized and resolved with ambiguity handling first. Missing or unreadable profile/review extension tables follow the compatibility allow path; available strong-credential tables are preferred, and an existing credential forbids fallback to the legacy password column. Legacy compatibility upgrade is allowed only when that user has no strong credential. Callers remain responsible for throttling, session/Cookie issuance, and page authorization.

方法只返回成功、失败、需重置和安全版本等结果事实，不返回失败原因细节。标识会先归一化并通过解析器处理歧义；profile/注册审核扩展表缺失或读取异常按兼容策略放行，强凭据表可用时优先使用强哈希，存在凭据时禁止回退旧密码列；仅在无该用户强凭据时才允许一次 legacy 兼容升级。调用方仍须负责登录节流、会话/Cookie 和页面授权。

params.emailOrName.summary

Email, sign-in name, or employee code entered by the user.

用户输入的邮箱、登录名称或员工号。

params.password.summary

Submitted password input.

用户提交的密码输入。

returns.summary

Sign-in result; generic failure object on failure.

登录结果；失败时为通用失败对象。

Source
